authorized_semantic_read.columns: symbol plus trading-day/timestamp identity fields only

decision_rule.future_snapshot_eligible: Separate from source-family validity; requires a later frozen snapshot whose coverage includes the full preregistered future OOS window for both symbols.
decision_rule.invalid_binding: Any missing/duplicate member, digest mismatch, missing identity fields, unreadable parquet, or symbol mismatch.
decision_rule.source_family_valid: Each exact frozen member is unique, digest-verified, readable as parquet, contains the expected symbol and no other symbol, and exposes a usable trading-day or timestamp identity field.

prohibitions: read labels, outcomes, predictions, scores or PnL
fit or execute the Risk Tool model or calibration
reuse or substitute a carrier under the already revealed parent confirmatory claim
grant strategy routing, position sizing, PnL or production authority
purpose: Identify and validate the immutable paired per-symbol 5-minute carrier family for future cross-symbol Risk Tool OOS work after the revealed parent fresh-OOS carrier-binding mismatch.
